npx --yes @mcpjam/cli@6.2.2 --no-telemetry cloud eval status --run run_fixture_1 --project project_fixture
npx --yes @mcpjam/cli@6.2.2 --no-telemetry cloud eval iterations --run run_fixture_1 --project project_fixture
